question: Among all the Re:Zero anime performances so far, could you tell us about any voice actors' performances that left a particularly strong impression on you?
answer:
Of course, the famous scenes have left an impression on me, but I also really like the little ad-libs that get slipped in here and there.

The ad-libbed parts are basically things that aren't written in the main story, so they're places where you can really see how the actor has understood that character. It's fun when you get something like, “I don't know about this myself, but this character would probably do something like this.”

And also, I'll never forget the shock I felt the first time I heard Petelgeuse. (laughs)
